job.command:
stardev
#-------------------------------------------- # SUMS preserves the sim_to_jet/ subfolder when packaging the # SandBox, but everything below expects it flat in the job's # working directory (StRoot/ and .sl73_x8664_gcc485/ are left # alone -- the STAR build system expects those names/locations # as-is). #-------------------------------------------- cp sim_to_jet/* . cp shared/* .
if ( "pythia8" == "pythia8" ) then ln -sf starsim_pythia8_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia8" else ln -sf starsim_pythia6_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia6" endif
#-------------------------------------------- # Random seed #-------------------------------------------- set seed_temp=`od -vAn -N4 -tu4 < /dev/urandom` set myseed=`expr ${seed_temp} % 100000` set run_number = ${JOBINDEX}
#-------------------------------------------- # ptHatMin for this job: either a flat value, or one drawn from a # JSON-defined relative-proportion table (see header comment). #-------------------------------------------- set round_jobs = 400 set reference_jobs = 20000 @ scaled_index = ${JOBINDEX} * ${reference_jobs} / ${round_jobs}
if (${scaled_index} < 21) then set ptcut = 0 else if (${scaled_index} < 239) then set ptcut = 2 else if (${scaled_index} < 379) then set ptcut = 4 else if (${scaled_index} < 521) then set ptcut = 6 else if (${scaled_index} < 1522) then set ptcut = 8 else if (${scaled_index} < 5014) then set ptcut = 10 else if (${scaled_index} < 7897) then set ptcut = 12 else if (${scaled_index} < 10903) then set ptcut = 14 else if (${scaled_index} < 14241) then set ptcut = 16 else if (${scaled_index} < 17678) then set ptcut = 18 else if (${scaled_index} < 18754) then set ptcut = 20 else if (${scaled_index} < 19735) then set ptcut = 22 else if (${scaled_index} < 19852) then set ptcut = 24 else if (${scaled_index} < 19868) then set ptcut = 26 else if (${scaled_index} < 19881) then set ptcut = 28 else if (${scaled_index} < 19891) then set ptcut = 30 else if (${scaled_index} < 19901) then set ptcut = 32 else if (${scaled_index} < 19913) then set ptcut = 34 else if (${scaled_index} < 19918) then set ptcut = 36 else if (${scaled_index} < 19934) then set ptcut = 38 else if (${scaled_index} < 19942) then set ptcut = 40 else if (${scaled_index} < 19950) then set ptcut = 42 else if (${scaled_index} < 19956) then set ptcut = 44 else if (${scaled_index} < 19969) then set ptcut = 46 else if (${scaled_index} < 19973) then set ptcut = 48 else if (${scaled_index} < 19979) then set ptcut = 50 else if (${scaled_index} < 19984) then set ptcut = 52 else if (${scaled_index} < 19990) then set ptcut = 54 else if (${scaled_index} < 19994) then set ptcut = 56 else if (${scaled_index} < 19997) then set ptcut = 58 else set ptcut = 60 endif
echo "========================================" echo "Generator = pythia8 (tune/PDF param=0)" echo "ptHatMin = ${ptcut} GeV" echo "nevents = 5000" echo "Save SimpleTree = 0" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Random seed = ${myseed}" echo "========================================"
mkdir -p /star/data01/pwg/seanp/tunes/pythia8_nnpdf23lo_R035
echo "Starting detector simulation..."
root4star -q -b starsim.C\(5000,${myseed},${ptcut},0\)
echo "Finished detector simulation." echo "" echo "Starting reconstruction..."
root4star -b -q runSimBfc.C\(5000,1,\"${pid}\"\) root4star -b -q readMudst.C\(0,1,\"${pid}.MuDst.root\"\)
echo "Finished reconstruction."
#-------------------------------------------- # Jet finding on this single SimpleTree file (JetMatcher takes a # list-file argument, so we write a one-line list rather than # modify JetMatcher.cpp -- functionally it's a single file in, # single file out). #--------------------------------------------
module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
echo "Compiling JetMatcher..." g++ -m64 JetMatcher.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o JetMatcher \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -lEG \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
echo "SimpleTree_mudst.root" > single_file.list
./JetMatcher single_file.list mv jet_output.root jet_output_pythia8_0_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root
#-------------------------------------------- # Keep or discard the intermediate SimpleTree #-------------------------------------------- if ( 0 == 1 ) then mv SimpleTree_mudst.root SimpleTree_pythia8_0_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root else rm -f SimpleTree_mudst.root endif
# Temporary, job-local only; never meant to leave scratch. rm -f single_file.list
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
